scope: 2015 seven-role standard Pandemic base core only; no Legacy, expansions, puzzle or scenario rules.
verdict_rationale: The core game procedures, costs, destinations, timing, role exceptions and end conditions are supported. One small omission in the Dispatcher row leaves consent explicit for only one of its two special movement modes. No major rules error or important mechanics omission was identified.

findings.claim: The Dispatcher row includes owner permission in the first movement option, then gives moving another player's pawn as if it were your own without repeating or unambiguously extending that condition.
findings.finding: Both special movement modes require the pawn owner's agreement. The second mode in the source explicitly repeats that requirement; the summary places its permission parenthesis inside the first option before OR. This leaves a small ambiguity about compulsory movement in the second mode.
findings.impact: A literal reading could permit directing another player's ordinary movement without consent. The surrounding first-option permission makes intended cooperative consent inferable, so this is minor rather than a core mechanics failure.

checked_claims.claim: Cooperative four-color cure objective, all players win/lose together; eight outbreaks, insufficient needed cubes, or inability to draw two cards cause loss. Detailed end conditions correctly refine overview shorthand.
Component quantities including seven roles and pawns, 59 Player cards (48/6/5), 48 Infection cards, 96 cubes (24/color), four cure markers and reference cards, six stations.
Atlanta station and pawns; markers at zero and near indicators vial-side up; unused roles/pawns removed; separate cube supplies.
Starting hands are four/three/two cards for two/three/four players, shuffled City and Event cards without Epidemics.
Four/five/six Epidemics define Introductory/Standard/Heroic; equal face-down piles, one shuffled Epidemic each, smaller piles on bottom, unused Epidemics removed.
Initial nine-city infection uses three cities at three cubes, three at two, three at one; rate starts at leftmost two, nine cards discarded, remaining cards form deck.
Highest population City card determines starting player; leftward turn order, active player decides with advice allowed.
Up to four actions, repeats cost one action each; draw two together; resolve Epidemics before hand enforcement; then infect.
Movement costs/destinations and station-to-station shuttle are correct; white-line wrapping includes Sydney/Los Angeles. Direct Flight was verified visually because extraction omits its body.
Build station requires current-city card, station supply, or relocation from board when all six are built; set aside surplus supplied pieces.

source_references.section: Build a Research Station; station limit callout

checked_claims.claim: Treatment returns one cube to supply, or all of one cured color; separate colors need separate actions.
Share Knowledge transfers matching-city City card either direction with co-location and consent; immediate hand limit.
Discover a Cure at any station discards five same-color City cards (four Scientist), moves cure marker; station-city color irrelevant. Existing cubes remain.

Eradication only follows cure plus zero cubes, immediately if zero when cured; flip marker, no further infections/epidemic cubes, unnecessary for victory; uncured zero cubes has no eradication effect.

source_references.section: Treat Disease; Discover a Cure; eradication callout

checked_claims.claim: Player draw loss occurs when fewer than two cards remain at required draw, with no discard reshuffle; no Epidemic replacement.

Epidemic order Increase/Infect/Intensify; bottom Infection card; three matching cubes or fill to three then outbreak if already infected; discard card; shuffle only Infection discard onto deck. Eradication and role exceptions preserved elsewhere.

Two Epidemics fully resolve in sequence, Events allowed between; absent modifying Events the second Intensify puts its sole newly discarded card on top. Subsequent outbreak expectation includes relevant prevention exceptions.

Infection rate is 2/2/2/3/3/4/4; normal infections resolve top cards individually, matching cube unless eradicated, outbreak rather than fourth, then discard. Rate sequence verified on printed track image.

Outbreak increases marker, spreads outbreak color to each connected city, chains after current outbreak, no cube/repeat outbreak back into a city already outbreaking this card; multiple colors up to three each; eighth outbreak immediately loses.
Cube shortage loses immediately only when unable to place actually required cubes of that color, including epidemic, outbreak and normal infection.
Seven-card hand limit counts Player cards, not Role/Reference; enforce immediately upon transfer and after Epidemic resolution for draws.

Events cost no action, any player may play, player chooses effect; prohibited between drawing and resolving a card; normally discarded. Introductory open hands, standard/heroic private with optional experienced open hands; discard piles inspectable.

Airlift moves any pawn to any city with other-owner permission; One Quiet Night skips next Infect Cities, not Epidemic Infect; Resilient Population removes any one Infection discard card and explicitly allows Infect/Intensify timing.

Forecast draws/looks at/rearranges the top six Infection cards and returns them on top. Actual card photo inspected; matching art/title/component design corroborated by publisher component image.

checked_claims.claim: Contingency Planner spends action to store one discarded Event on role, outside hand; stored Event removed from game upon use.

Dispatcher movement destinations, action cost, own-hand flight payments and moved-pawn Charter origin, nonmovement prohibition and Operations Expert exclusion match; consent wording is incomplete for second movement mode.

checked_claims.claim: Medic treats all cubes of a selected color; cured-color automatic removal on entry/presence, including Dispatcher/Airlift moves on others turns; protects current city from cured cubes/outbreaks only.
Operations Expert builds at current city as action with no City card, or once per turn spends action plus any City card to move from station to any city.
Quarantine Specialist prevents all-color cube placement/outbreaks in own and connected cities, with setup exception.
Researcher can transfer any City card only from own hand to co-located other player on either turn; Scientist needs four same-color cards.

source_adequacy.assessment: Adequate for the requested base-core rules audit with the documented supplemental Event evidence.
source_adequacy.primary: Read all 683 lines of extracted/pandemic-rules.txt and visually inspected all eight matching 2015 publisher rulebook pages. Image inspection supplies extraction omissions including Direct Flight text, starting-hand numbers, infection-rate track values and marker symbols.
source_adequacy.government_grant: Used only the enlarged Government Grant base card on official-event-puzzle.pdf page 2; excluded all puzzle/scenario context and other nonbase cards visible on that page.
source_adequacy.forecast: Inspected the actual legible printed Forecast card photograph. Its exact six-card/top-return instruction is visible. Publisher official-components-2.webp visually corroborates matching card title/art/design, but its overlapping components obscure part of the effect; the full effect is established by the photographed printed card.
limitations: Forecast's complete effect is available here through a third-party-hosted physical-component photograph, not a fully legible publisher-hosted card face. Supplied provenance and publisher component appearance support the match.

The 45-minute play-time and BGG identifier metadata are not established by the supplied rulebook; they are outside this mechanical rules audit. Historical verification/extraction date metadata and the preexisting verified badge were not accepted as evidence of correctness.

matching-extraction.txt and the authoritative repository extraction are byte-different; the audit used the requested authoritative extraction and matching page images rather than assuming byte equivalence.
No external rule variants, expansions, Legacy rules, puzzle mechanics, questions, answer keys or reader assessments were used.
